items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson scheduled for MRI on ankle today after leaving stadium in walking boot; did not return from injury vs Titans. Rapoport notes initial thought day-to-day.
items.why: Left ankle injury scrambling; boot postgame; MRI pending.
items.implication: Hold; monitor MRI. Huntley filled in. Ravens offense changes without him.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled out with concussion after hit in first half vs Jaguars; Tee Higgins also suffered adductor injury. Both Bengals top WRs banged up.
items.why: Concussion protocol after facemask/hit; Higgins adductor.
items.implication: Chase likely multi-week protocol average ~9 days. Higgins status TBD; Burrow volume may shift.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WRs if both limited.

items.text: Post-Sunday injuries watching: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring), Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot aggr), DJ Moore (shoulder), others including Pat Bryant (ankle).
items.implication: Priority monitoring for Week 5 statuses; beneficiaries reverse on returns.

items.text: Chiefs downgraded Rashee Rice to doubtful with hamstring tweak; did not return. Will use bye to recover. Thornton dislocated ankle out indefinitely.
items.why: Hamstring tweak first quarter; Reid called tweak. Thornton separate dislocated ankle.
items.implication: Rice short-term; Chiefs WR room thin. Interest in Tyreek Hill noted.
items.opportunity: Targets to Worthy/others; Hill potential signing.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled out after right hamstring injury early vs Rams (pulled up on sweep); left after few carries. Eagles already depleted.
items.why: Hamstring pull; ruled out first half. Managing prior stinger.
items.implication: Monitor practice for Week 5 London. Do not cut; IR candidate if multi-week.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries expand (Bigsby noted in reports).

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore aggravated shoulder injury; not considered long-term issue as of now. Left early; ETR watching.
items.why: Aggravated existing; source says not long-term.
items.implication: Monitor but likely short absence; hold.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion). Situation worsening.
items.why: Smith/Goedert already out; Johnson personal added Q; Baun concussion.
items.implication: Offense depleted vs Rams; Hurts/protection impacted. Fantasy fades for remaining.
items.opportunity: Wicks or others for TE/WR snaps; reverse if unexpected returns.

items.text: Bigger dock on Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs); expected to play but active then foot aggravation, limited production/left. ETR listed expected pregame.
items.why: Foot/ribs history; LP-DNP-LP week; Schefter confirmed active but aggravated in game.
items.implication: Tricky nagging; monitor for Week 5. Bigger projection dock justified.
items.opportunity: Reduced routes if limited; teammates benefit short-term.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) now; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Expected to play full; was IN/full participant.
items.why: Schefter: no intention to limit snaps; conditioning may affect but enter with full plan. ETR expected.
items.implication: Start with confidence; small projection dock only. Returned productively.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected hard pitch count per beat. ETR expected to play.
items.why: No hard pitch count; minor dock only.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/optimistic but bigger dock (ribs); ETR listed GTD.
items.why: Ribs; bigger projection dock than peers.

items.text: Terry McLaurin not expected to play; listed in NOT EXPECTED alongside Coker/Allen. Inactive context from reports.
items.why: ETR summary weekend reports: not expected.
items.implication: Sit; Commanders WR depth thin with Daniels also out.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role questions who ends up starting and crushing.
items.why: Role solidification and production vs doubts.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (ankle maintenance/body); limited second-half snaps in close game despite no new injury. Coaches managing workload long season.
items.why: Self-described not 100%; coaches limit for freshness; accepted backup in crunch.
items.implication: Snap share capped; frustration but managed. Monitor role.
items.opportunity: Reduced if managed; backups get goal-line/third-down looks.
